subject: general
question: A shopkeeper mixes 30 kg of rice which he purchased at Rs. 30/kg and 40 kg of rice which he purchased at Rs.28/kg and he sells the entire mixture at Rs. 28/kg. What is the profit or loss percentage (approximated to nearest integer)?
solution:
Given:

A shopkeeper mixes 30 kg of rice which he purchased at Rs. 30/kg and 40 kg of rice which he purchased at Rs.28/kg and he sells the entire mixture at Rs. 28/kg. 

Concept used:

Loss% = {(Cost Price - Selling Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%
